_comment: Network emulation profiles for tc netem, applied by scripts/60-netem-plc.sh. Values are STARTING POINTS to calibrate against published HomePlug GreenPHY / PLC measurements (see docs/measurement-plan.md section 3). The freshness check evaluation sweeps these and reports false-reject rates per profile.

plc-clean.description: Low-load HomePlug GreenPHY link, short cable. Order of a few ms one-way.

plc-typical.description: Moderate PLC load and noise; used as the default calibration point.

plc-noisy.description: Noisy PLC segment (crosstalk, EMI). Stress case for the freshness bound.

relay-cellular.description: Extra leg added on the relay backchannel only (fake SECC <-> attacker EVCC exchange). Models the cellular relay hop the attack paper assumes (RTT well under 100 ms).

relay-wifi.description: Best case for the attacker: local Wi-Fi relay backchannel. Smallest detectable relay delay.
